Here's what I have in a greasemonkey script:

var onlyRemoveOnDark = true;
var disabled = new Array("pics");
if( !onlyRemoveOnDark || document.body.classList.contains("dark") )
{
 for( var i = 0; i < disabled.length; i++ )
 {
 if( window.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(disabled[i].toLowerCase()) !== -1 )
 {
 var ccss;
 while( (ccss = document.getElementById('custom_css')) !== undefined )
 ccss.parentNode.removeChild(ccss);
 }
 }
}

There's currently a bug on comments pages where the style#custom_css element is inserted twice into the page, so your script will only work on subverse front pages.

Also you can check document.body.classList.contains("dark") rather than using getElementsByClassName which has to traverse the entire DOM.
